name: Conjure Barrage

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry. Level, school, classes, casting time, range, components, duration and Concentration match the D&D Beyond 2024 spell list.

components.m: a Melee or Ranged weapon worth at least 1 CP

targets.description: creatures of your choice in the Cone

summary: 60-foot Cone of spectral weapons: Dex save, 5d8 Force, half on a success.
text: You brandish the weapon used in the casting and conjure spectral copies of it, which launch forward and then vanish. Each creature of your choice in a 60-foot Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d8 Force damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3.
